name: Redis Vector Store
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Redis Vector Store node to interact with your Redis database as a vector store[^1]. You can insert documents into the vector database, get documents from the vector database, retrieve documents using a retriever connected to a chain[^2], or connect it directly to an agent[^3] to use as a tool[^4]

options: Name: The name of the vector store

parameters.name: Metadata Filter
parameters.description: The Metadata Filter option limits results to documents whose metadata matches a filter. It's available for the Get Many, Retrieve Documents (As Vector Store for Chain/Tool), and Retrieve Documents (As Tool for AI Agent) operation modes. The filter syntax depends on the node version

parameters.name: Redis query filters in node version 1.4
parameters.description: From node version 1.4, Metadata Filter takes a Redis query expression. You can filter on tag, numeric, text, and geo fields, and combine conditions with AND and OR logic. A filter only works on a field that the index stores with a matching type. Refer to Metadata Schema to set field types

parameters.name: Comma-separated filters in node version 1.3 and earlier
parameters.description: In node version 1.3 and earlier, Metadata Filter takes a comma-separated list of words, for example Item1,Item2,Item3. The node runs an OR query, so a document matches if at least one of the words matches

parameters.name: Metadata Schema
parameters.description: The Metadata Schema option sets the type of each metadata field in the index. It's available from node version 1.4 for the Insert Documents, Get Many, Retrieve Documents (As Vector Store for Chain/Tool), and Retrieve Documents (As Tool for AI Agent) operation modes

parameters.name: upgradeNotice
parameters.displayName: A newer version of this node supports advanced filtering and a custom metadata schema. To use it, add a new Redis Vector Store node with a new index, then reimport your documents. Don't point the new node at an index created by this version: metadata will be missing and filters will return wrong results. This node and its index keep working as they are.
